primitives.name: Pluggable CAPTCHA Solver Registry
primitives.verbatim_quote: It actually ships `pkg/engine/headless/captcha/` — a full identify-and-solve subsystem for recaptcha v2/v3/ enterprise, turnstile and hcaptcha, with `RegisterSolver()` as a pluggable registry and a CapSolver backend, plus `browser/stealth/assets.go`.
primitives.assumptions: Registry supports dynamic solver injection at runtime with version compatibility checks.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When CAPTCHA challenge exceeds solver capacity or registry misconfiguration occurs.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's stealth engine state transition function where solver selection triggers replay logic.
layer2.telemetry: Number of successful CAPTCHA solves per session

primitives.name: Cloudflare Wall Clearance Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is a wall-clear-and-replay library: `antibot/cloudflare/` returns `cf_clearance` bound to the exact UA so plain HTTP replays the cleared session.
primitives.assumptions: Wall clearance is deterministic given correct UA and session context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Upon CAPTCHA bypass failure or UA mismatch during replay.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's request routing logic when handling blocked responses.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of requests cleared by wall engine

primitives.name: Runtime Boundary Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Runtime boundary** — TypeScript (`packages/`, `apps/web`) and Python (`intelligence/`) are the only runtimes.
primitives.assumptions: Cross-runtime communication is limited to defined interfaces.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When attempting to import non-conforming language constructs into restricted environments.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI's data flow graph where runtime boundaries define valid transformation paths.
layer2.telemetry: Number of inter-language calls successfully executed
